notes: Final step of the consolidation. The four watchlist symbol-list tools — create_watchlist, list_watchlists, get_watchlist, edit_watchlist — are gone. Everything they did now has a cohort equivalent: create_cohort, list_cohorts, the cohort drill-down, and edit_cohort. Keeping both was the duplication that made a watchlist and a cohort feel like two things when they are one. The watchlist store stays — not as a user surface, but because a few internal consumers still read it: the one-time migration that turns your old watchlists into cohorts, and the "is this symbol one of mine" cross-references
